message: Joanna, the Creative Commons Web site is at [http://creativecommons.org/](http://creativecommons.org/). For a really good general introduction to the issues at stake, [this Lawrence Lessig presentation](http://legacy.randomfoo.net/oscon/2002/lessig/) that Clancy pointed me to is well worth taking the time to watch and listen to, but you'll want to do it somewhere with a fast connection and sound. The wikipedia article on [copyleft](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copyleft) goes into considerable and very useful depth, but the article on [open publishing](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_publishing) is unfortunately less helpful. I'm sure Clancy can recommend other, better sources.
